mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT A.NAME AS "name", A.ACCOMMODATION_TYPE AS "type", A.REGION AS "region", A.PRICE_MIN AS "priceMin", A.PRICE_MAX AS "priceMax", A.FACILITIES AS "facilities", A.VIEW_COUNT AS "viewCount", NVL((SELECT ROUND(AVG(R.RATING), 1) FROM ACCOMMODATION_REVIEW R WHERE R.ACCOMMODATION_NO = A.ACCOMMODATION_NO AND R.STATUS = 'A'), 0) AS "avgRating", NVL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ACCOMMODATION_REVIEW R WHERE R.ACCOMMODATION_NO = A.ACCOMMODATION_NO AND R.STATUS = 'A'), 0) AS "reviewCount" FROM ACCOMMODATION A WHERE A.STATUS = 'A' ORDER BY A.VIEW_COUNT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 15
SELECT S.SPOT_TITLE AS "title", S.SPOT_DESC AS "description", S.SPOT_LOCATION AS "location", S.SPOT_TAG AS "tag" FROM SPOT S WHERE S.SPOT_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY S.SPOT_ORDER ASC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT C.TITLE AS "title", TO_CHAR(C.TRAVEL_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "travelDate", C.MAX_MEMBERS AS "maxMembers", C.TAGS AS "tags", NVL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMPANION_JOIN J WHERE J.COMPANION_NO = C.COMPANION_NO AND J.STATUS = 'A'), 0) AS "joinCount" FROM COMPANION_BOARD C WHERE C.STATUS = 'Y' AND C.TRAVEL_DATE >= SYSDATE ORDER BY C.CREATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT B.TITLE AS "title", B.VIEW_COUNT AS "viewCount" FROM BOARD B WHERE B.STATUS = 'A' ORDER BY B.VIEW_COUNT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "totalCount", ROUND(AVG(RATING), 1) AS "avgRating" FROM ACCOMMODATION_REVIEW WHERE STATUS = 'A'
